description: An ensemble chorus: four delay lines emulating a bucket-brigade chip, each swept by a slow and a fast sine, giving a stereo pair from a mono input

params.text: Sets how fast the sweeps run; the slow one moves between 0.005Hz and 5Hz and the fast one between 0.5Hz and 40Hz together
Sets how far the delays are swept, and so how deep the chorusing is
Sets how much of each channel's output is fed back into its delay lines, up to 0.39 of it; the feedback is high-passed at 240Hz so it cannot build up on the bass
Mixes the chorus against the dry signal, all dry at the left and all chorus at the right

inputs.text: The audio to be chorused; the same signal feeds both channels

outputs.text: One of the two channels; it carries the same input through two delay lines whose sweeps start a third of a cycle away from the other channel's

notes: the input is mono and the two outputs differ only in the starting phase of their sweeps, so one of them patched alone gives the chorus without the stereo spread.
the module has no menu of its own beyond Rack's.

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only
